items.author: garyhollins62@mailbox.example
items.title: drivers christmas breakfast
items.body: Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage again. We want to do the christmas breakfast at your place like always, Saturday Dec 20 if the back room is open. Figure about 20 of us maybe 22. Same as last time with the big pans of eggs and potatoes and everybody orders there own meat. Separate checks please, last time that worked fine. 7am ok? Thanks Gary

items.author: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
items.title: RE: drivers christmas breakfast
items.body: Gary! Of course, you're on the books for the 20th, back room, 7am. Family style eggs, home fries and biscuits and gravy is $11 a head, meats ordered off the menu. I can do separate checks but I'll need one person to give me a final count by the Wednesday before so I'm not wasting food. Coffee is bottomless as always. See you then, Rhonda - Linden Pike Diner

items.author: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
items.title: thank you
items.body: Thanks to you and your crew for Saturday. Sorry again about running out of coffee around 8:15, we had a urn go out on us and the new girl didn't catch it. We'll have a backup next time. Tell everybody Merry Christmas. Rhonda

items.author: dwayne.pruitt@mailbox.example
items.title: breakfast list
items.body: Gary here's the sign up sheet off the board in the drivers room. 19 drivers, 3 from the shop, and Earl plus his wife so 24 if you count them. Patsy says she can't do eggs anymore, she needs something else. Also Lonnie is on the walker now since his hip so he needs to get in without the steps. Dwayne

items.author: carol.mabry@mailbox.example
items.title: Earl
items.body: Hi Gary, this is Carol, Earl's wife. He doesn't know a thing about this so please keep it quiet. His last day driving is December 18 after 31 years. He'd be embarrassed by a big speech but he'd love it if the guys did something. He loves those cinnamon rolls. Thank you for doing this. Carol

items.author: orders@sugarcreekbakery.example
items.title: Re: sheet cake quote
items.body: Hi Gary, a half sheet cake serves about 30 and runs $48, with writing and a little bus on top it's $56. We need 5 days notice. Pickup only, we open at 6am Saturdays. Sugarcreek Bakery

items.author: dispatch@mvtransport.example
items.title: Route 14 and 22 changes starting Nov 16
items.body: All drivers: due to the bridge work on Wilmington Pike, routes 14 and 22 will detour on Patterson Rd starting Monday Nov 16. Add 6 minutes to your AM pickups. Updated route sheets in your boxes. - Dispatch

items.title: Your DOT physical follow up
items.body: Mr. Hollins, your blood pressure at today's DOT exam was 168/102. Your medical card has been issued for 3 months only instead of 2 years. Please follow up with your doctor about your lisinopril dose and return for a recheck by February 5, 2027.
